newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast CARB gasoline firm, sellers emerge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast CARB gasoline firm, sellers emerge.

text.p: U.S. West Coast refined product prices were mixed late Monday, with sellers emerging in the wake of firming CARB gasoline prices in Los Angeles, traders said.
Last Thursday's fire in a coker at Mobil Corp's 130,000 barrel per day Los Angeles-area refinery continued to be supportive to spot prices across the board, traders said.
Looking ahead, traders saw relatively active discussion in the days before the long Thanksgiving Day holiday. "Some guys are trying to square up positions before the weekend," one trader said.
CARB gasoline was heard done at 65.50 cents a gallon, with bids at 65 cents a gallon against 66 cents a gallon asked in Los Angeles. Bay Area CARB unleaded remained four cents weaker.
Jet fuel was bid 72.50 cents a gallon, asked 73 cents, with buyers in the market looking for sellers on December barrels, traders said.
CARB diesel was bid 72.50 cents a gallon, asked 74 cents in Los Angeles.
